# `/proc/uptime` texts and the whole seconds `unix.uptime_seconds` reports
# for each. Fields are tab-separated: the text, then the expectation.
# The first white-space separated field is read, only the part before the
# first `.` is used, and anything that is not an in-range integer reads 0.
17.42 3.91	17
0.9	0
-3.5	-3
abc	0
9223372036854775808.0	0
999999999999999999999	0
	0
  	0
